What the chart shows for brothers, sisters and courage does not all agree, but taken as a whole it leans favourably.

The ruler of your 9th house, Saturn, sits in your 1st house, a house that drains it, whatever the sign says. The degree Saturn holds in Taurus puts it, as the ruler of your 9th house, in a feeble state. The degree the Sun holds in Aquarius puts it, as the main planet of your father, in a feeble state. Among the rulers of the houses of brothers, sisters and courage, the Moon, which rules the 3rd house, sits in Libra in your 6th house, in a neutral sign, and together these rulers lean unfavourably. The Moon sits in Libra, the sign showing how others see brothers, sisters and courage, with no helpful planet beside, so this sign leans unfavourably. The main planet of brothers, sisters and courage, Mars, sits in your 7th house, a house that drains it, whatever the sign says.

For your father, the planets that rule the day you were born, Mars and the Moon, lean in a favourable direction. Looking at the rulers of the houses of your reputation, the lean is favourable, and Saturn, ruler of the 10th house, sits in Taurus in your 1st house, in a friendly sign. The divisional chart for your reputation leans favourably; there Mars falls in Capricorn, exalted, where it is at its best. For your reputation, the planets that rule the day you were born, Mars and the Moon, lean in a favourable direction. Budhaditya, the combination of the Sun and Mercury, is in your chart: the Sun and Mercury in your 10th house bear on your reputation and brothers, sisters and courage, with Mercury being in a feeble state softening it. Your chart holds raja yoga (the rulers of an angular house and of a trine house joined), formed by the Sun and Mercury in your 10th house, and it bears on your reputation. The houses behind brothers, sisters and courage lean favourably as a group, and the main one, your 3rd house in Cancer, is better supported than most among your twelve houses. For brothers, sisters and courage, the planets that rule the day you were born, Mars and the Moon, lean in a favourable direction.

Your current period is that of Jupiter, within that of Mercury, running until November 2028; Jupiter and Mercury have a hand in your father, your reputation and brothers, sisters and courage.
